labels.name: status:planned
labels.description: Approved backlog item not yet started

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Blocked by another issue or owner decision

milestones.title: v0.3.0 — Secure ephemeral rooms
milestones.description: Durable anonymous rooms, capability security, locked rosters, lifecycle, and authoritative commands.

milestones.title: v0.4.0 — Authoritative realtime
milestones.description: Multi-device convergence over committed server state with recovery and degraded operation.

milestones.title: v0.5.0 — Trustworthy place data
milestones.description: Licensed nearby discovery with provenance, freshness, constraints, and honest fallback.

milestones.title: v0.6.0 — Closed beta readiness
milestones.description: Operationally supported beta with privacy-safe evidence, accessibility, and recovery.

milestones.title: v0.7.0 — Repeat-group utility
milestones.description: Consented repeat-group value, saved preferences, history, and scheduled rituals.

milestones.title: v0.8.0 — Handoffs and monetization
milestones.description: Transparent reservation/order handoffs and ethical monetization experiments.

milestones.title: v0.9.0 — Expansion and scale
milestones.description: New decision categories, calibration, abuse defense, failover, and scale proof.

milestones.title: v1.0.0 — Trustworthy launch
milestones.description: Launch criteria, independent audits, operability, economics, and release evidence.

issues.title: Select and approve the transactional database provider
issues.outcome: Choose a PostgreSQL-compatible provider under ADR 0007 without provisioning before owner approval.
acceptance: Comparison records free allowance, spend controls, terms, portability, recovery, and migration threshold
Accepted ADR names the provider and degradation plan
Non-production provisioning and teardown require explicit owner approval

issues.title: Implement the room schema and forward-only migrations
issues.outcome: Create durable rooms, participants, constraints, candidates, ballots, decisions, commands, and outbox records.
acceptance: Migrations run in order against disposable PostgreSQL
Uniqueness, revision, foreign-key, and idempotency constraints are enforced
Retention and deletion paths are represented

issues.title: Implement anonymous capability issuance and hashing
issues.outcome: Issue room-scoped host and participant capabilities while storing only cryptographic hashes.
acceptance: Raw capabilities never enter storage, logs, analytics, or error payloads
Capabilities are scoped to one room, member, role, and expiry
Cross-room attempts fail indistinguishably

issues.title: Implement the idempotent room command API
issues.outcome: Accept versioned room commands with authorization, compare-and-set revisions, and participant sequences.
acceptance: Duplicate idempotency keys return the prior result without reapplying
Stale revisions have a documented recoverable response
Every accepted mutation and outbox append share one transaction

issues.title: Define versioned room protocol contracts
issues.outcome: Define provider-neutral runtime contracts for room commands, projections, roles, phases, revisions, and errors.
acceptance: Every external payload has a runtime parser and bounded fields
Protocol versions and compatibility rules are documented
Tests reject malformed, oversized, unsafe, and secret-bearing inputs

issues.title: Build room creation and invitation locator flow
issues.outcome: Let a host create a temporary room and share a friendly locator that grants no authority by itself.
acceptance: Room codes are non-authoritative and resistant to enumeration
Join links never embed host authority
Expired, missing, and unauthorized rooms are indistinguishable

issues.title: Enforce participant roster lifecycle and round locking
issues.outcome: Make join, leave, host approval, quorum, dropout, and roster lock explicit server transitions.
acceptance: Starting a round snapshots the eligible roster
Late participants cannot silently change unanimity or quorum
Dropout handling is explicit, versioned, and tested

issues.title: Implement room expiry, retention, and deletion
issues.outcome: Expire temporary rooms and delete sensitive room data on a documented lifecycle.
acceptance: Expiry is enforced server-side and visible to clients
Deletion is idempotent and covers projections, commands, ballots, and capabilities
Tests verify no expired room can be revived accidentally

issues.title: Implement host recovery and capability rotation
issues.outcome: Recover host control without accounts while revoking superseded capabilities.
acceptance: Recovery requires an explicit short-lived flow
Rotation invalidates prior host authority atomically
Recovery attempts are rate-limited and never reveal room existence

issues.title: Build privacy-minimized authorized room projections
issues.outcome: Return only the room state each host or participant role is allowed to observe.
acceptance: Individual constraints and ballots are not exposed beyond the approved contract
Projection responses are revisioned and no-store
Snapshot tests prevent accidental sensitive-field expansion

issues.title: Add command concurrency and duplicate-delivery tests
issues.outcome: Prove correctness when commands race, repeat, arrive stale, or use invalid participant sequences.
acceptance: Parallel tests cover duplicate vote, roster lock, resolve, and expiry races
No acknowledged command is applied twice
Database constraints and application errors agree

issues.title: Document migration, backup, restore, and provider teardown
issues.outcome: Create reversible operational procedures for the first durable store.
acceptance: Disposable restore produces the expected schema and fixture room
Rollback limitations and forward-fix procedure are explicit
Provider teardown removes non-production data without exposing secrets

issues.title: Add room-code abuse, enumeration, and rate controls
issues.outcome: Bound anonymous create, locate, join, and recovery attempts without collecting invasive identity.
acceptance: Per-origin and per-room limits have safe defaults and kill switches
Responses do not become a room enumeration oracle
Legitimate small groups receive accessible retry guidance

issues.title: Complete the secure-room threat model and exit review
issues.outcome: Review the complete 0.3 attack surface and verify the milestone exit gate.
acceptance: Threat model covers capabilities, CSRF, replay, fixation, enumeration, retention, and insider access
Release-critical findings have owners and tests
Milestone evidence records an explicit pass or deferral rationale

issues.title: Select and approve the realtime transport
issues.outcome: Measure transports without allowing realtime delivery to become authoritative.
acceptance: Evaluation covers acknowledgement, fan-out, auth, quotas, observability, recovery, and cost
Accepted ADR preserves transactional authority
Provisioning requires explicit owner approval

issues.title: Implement the transactional outbox publisher
issues.outcome: Publish committed room projections with retry and bounded retention.
acceptance: Committed transitions are eventually visible
Uncommitted transitions are never published
Repeated publication is harmless

issues.title: Implement revision reconciliation and recovery
issues.outcome: Detect projection gaps and converge clients on the current committed revision.
acceptance: Gap detection fetches an authorized current projection
Duplicate and reordered events do not regress state
Reconnect produces deterministic convergence

issues.title: Define versioned realtime event envelopes
issues.outcome: Specify event identity, room revision, type, timestamp semantics, compatibility, and privacy boundaries.
acceptance: Parsers reject unknown unsafe shapes while supporting documented compatibility
Events never carry raw capabilities or private ballots
Golden fixtures cover every event version

issues.title: Add transactional outbox schema and retention
issues.outcome: Persist publishable events alongside accepted commands.
acceptance: Outbox insert is atomic with aggregate revision
Records support lease, retry, poison state, and expiry
Indexes support bounded publisher scans

issues.title: Implement publisher leases, retries, and poison-event visibility
issues.outcome: Operate multiple publishers without duplicate side effects or silent poison records.
acceptance: Leases recover after crashes
Retry uses bounded backoff and dead-letter visibility
Operator metrics expose lag and poison count

issues.title: Authorize room subscriptions and channel membership
issues.outcome: Ensure only current room capabilities can subscribe to allowed projections.
acceptance: Revoked and expired capabilities lose subscription access
Cross-room subscription attempts reveal nothing
Channel identifiers do not confer authority

issues.title: Build the client revision state machine
issues.outcome: Model connecting, current, stale, reconciling, degraded, and terminal room states.
acceptance: State transitions are deterministic and unit tested
UI never presents pending state as committed
Revision regression is impossible

issues.title: Add degraded polling fallback
issues.outcome: Continue safe read progress when realtime is unavailable.
acceptance: Polling is bounded, jittered, authorized, and no-store
UI clearly identifies degraded mode
Recovery returns to realtime without duplicate commands

issues.title: Add offline and pending-command UX
issues.outcome: Show connectivity and command acknowledgement honestly on mobile.
acceptance: Unacknowledged votes remain visibly pending
Replay is bounded and idempotent
Offline UI never claims synchronized completion

issues.title: Build a network partition and event disorder simulator
issues.outcome: Exercise delay, loss, duplicates, reorder, reconnect, and publisher crashes deterministically.
acceptance: Scenarios are reproducible with seeds
Failures retain traces without sensitive room data
Simulator runs in CI within a bounded time

issues.title: Verify multi-device convergence and realtime SLOs
issues.outcome: Prove two to eight clients converge without split brain under target conditions.
acceptance: Multi-browser tests cover joins, votes, roster lock, result, reconnect, and expiry
No acknowledged vote is lost
Latency and recovery objectives are measured and documented

issues.title: Select and approve the licensed place provider
issues.outcome: Compare commercial providers for the launch geography under ADR 0005 and ADR 0007.
acceptance: Evaluation covers fields, coverage, terms, caching, attribution, quotas, cost, deletion, and handoffs
Accepted ADR defines migration and outage behavior
Provisioning requires explicit owner approval

issues.title: Implement the provenance-aware place adapter
issues.outcome: Normalize provider records without leaking vendor payloads into domain contracts.
acceptance: Every normalized field carries availability, provenance, and freshness
Malformed payloads fail closed
Contract fixtures prevent provider coupling

issues.title: Implement place quality metrics and outage behavior
issues.outcome: Measure completeness and freshness while degrading honestly during provider failure.
acceptance: Dashboards expose quality and outage states
Fallback never fabricates fields
Host receives actionable manual-entry alternatives

issues.title: Define privacy-preserving area and location input
issues.outcome: Support typed area, coarse location, and optional device location with explicit consent.
acceptance: Precise location is not retained beyond documented need
Permission denial preserves typed-area flow
Logs and analytics exclude coordinates

issues.title: Build mobile area search and map selection
issues.outcome: Let hosts choose a search area by text or map without making a map mandatory.
acceptance: Text-only, keyboard, and screen-reader paths are complete
Map controls are thumb-usable and responsive
Selected area is summarized before querying

issues.title: Implement bounded nearby candidate discovery
issues.outcome: Fetch a small decision-ready venue deck within server-side quotas.
acceptance: Per-room candidate cap, timeout, quota, and kill switch are enforced
Queries are server-side and secrets never reach clients
Empty and partial results are honest

issues.title: Expose field provenance and freshness in venue cards
issues.outcome: Make source, update time, estimated, missing, and host-confirmed facts understandable.
acceptance: Cards distinguish provider, host-confirmed, estimated, stale, and unavailable data
Accessibility labels convey the same meaning
No visual badge implies unsupported certainty

issues.title: Implement licensed venue photo handling
issues.outcome: Render provider-permitted venue media with attribution, fallbacks, and safe optimization.
acceptance: Photo terms, caching, and attribution are enforced
Broken or absent photos use a non-deceptive fallback
Responsive image budgets meet mobile targets

issues.title: Implement ratings and review-count honesty
issues.outcome: Show ratings and counts only when licensed, current, and correctly attributed.
acceptance: Rating scale and count source are explicit
Missing or stale data is not synthesized
Tests reject mismatched rating/count provenance

issues.title: Implement timezone-aware hours and open-now evidence
issues.outcome: Represent hours and target-time confidence without claiming certainty from incomplete schedules.
acceptance: Timezone and overnight hours are tested
Unknown and exceptional hours remain unknown
Target-time checks record source and freshness

issues.title: Model dietary and accessibility evidence separately
issues.outcome: Keep safety/access evidence distinct from general tags and popularity.
acceptance: Evidence supports confirmed yes, confirmed no, unknown, and stale
Hard constraints fail safely on insufficient evidence
Host corrections retain provenance

issues.title: Implement distance evidence and safe map handoff
issues.outcome: Show straight-line or provider route distance honestly and open supported map apps safely.
acceptance: Distance method and freshness are explicit
Handoff URLs are allowlisted and encoded
Unsupported devices receive a copyable address/search fallback

issues.title: Add place cache, circuit breaker, and quota kill switch
issues.outcome: Bound provider cost and outage impact while respecting license terms.
acceptance: Cache policy matches provider terms
Circuit breaker and kill switch are server-controlled
Quota exhaustion falls back without uncontrolled spend

issues.title: Add host corrections, removal, and manual fallback
issues.outcome: Let a host remove unsuitable venues or explicitly confirm missing evidence.
acceptance: Corrections identify host provenance and expire with the room
Removing a candidate cannot corrupt an active ballot
Manual entry remains available during provider outage

issues.title: Implement privacy-safe product measurement
issues.outcome: Implement ADR 0008 with minimized event schemas and retention controls.
acceptance: Schemas reject names, room codes, coordinates, candidates, constraints, and ballots
Events occur only after successful transitions
Sampling and retention are configurable

issues.title: Establish service indicators, alerts, and recovery exercises
issues.outcome: Create actionable operational signals and rehearse recovery.
acceptance: Indicators cover availability, command failures, outbox lag, provider quality, and deletion
Alerts have owners and runbooks
Exercises record recovery time and follow-ups

issues.title: Run the thirty-group validation study
issues.outcome: Evaluate product usefulness and guardrails with at least thirty completed real groups.
acceptance: Recruitment and consent follow the study plan
Evidence combines minimized metrics and interviews
Limitations and severe constraint incidents are recorded

issues.title: Implement explicit commitment and destination handoff
issues.outcome: Help participants commit and continue to maps or an approved reservation destination.
acceptance: Commitment is distinct from voting
Handoff never claims booking or live availability
Failure and return paths preserve the result

issues.title: Add voluntary feedback and research consent
issues.outcome: Collect optional structured feedback without attaching sensitive room content.
acceptance: Consent is explicit and revocable where applicable
Free text warns against sensitive details
Feedback retention and access are documented

issues.title: Complete independent accessibility audit and remediation
issues.outcome: Audit the entire create, join, vote, result, recovery, and deletion journey.
acceptance: Keyboard, screen reader, zoom, contrast, reduced motion, and touch targets are covered
Critical findings block release
Remediation includes regression tests

issues.title: Harden anonymous abuse and moderation controls
issues.outcome: Protect room creation, joins, text fields, and provider usage without identity profiling.
acceptance: Threat cases include flooding, offensive names, link sharing, and quota abuse
Controls have false-positive recovery
Moderation does not expose private room content unnecessarily

issues.title: Run beta load and capacity tests
issues.outcome: Measure realistic concurrent groups against free-tier and approved budget ceilings.
acceptance: Workload model and limits are documented
Tests identify saturation and graceful rejection behavior
Capacity assumptions feed cost forecasts

issues.title: Rehearse database backup and restore
issues.outcome: Prove room-state recovery within the beta objective.
acceptance: Restore is performed in an isolated environment
Integrity checks compare revisions, commands, and decisions
Secrets and participant data are handled safely

issues.title: Verify retention, expiry, and deletion in production-like data
issues.outcome: Demonstrate that sensitive room data expires and deletion completes.
acceptance: Synthetic expired rooms are removed on schedule
Deletion failures alert operators
Evidence contains no real room content

issues.title: Create support and incident response runbooks
issues.outcome: Give operators bounded procedures for participant, provider, privacy, and availability incidents.
acceptance: Runbooks define severity, ownership, communication, escalation, and recovery
Support intake warns against sharing capabilities or private room data
Tabletop exercise records gaps

issues.title: Run database, realtime, and place-provider outage drills
issues.outcome: Validate honest degraded states and recovery across external dependencies.
acceptance: Each dependency has injection, detection, user messaging, recovery, and rollback evidence
No drill fabricates committed state or place facts
Follow-up issues are prioritized

issues.title: Prepare beta recruitment, consent, and tester governance
issues.outcome: Define who tests, what is collected, how support works, and when access ends.
acceptance: Tester information and consent are plain language
Access and data lifecycle are bounded
Exclusion and stop criteria are explicit

issues.title: Record the beta go, pivot, or stop decision
issues.outcome: Judge the MVP against success, safety, retention, and cost evidence.
acceptance: Decision cites measured evidence and limitations
Unmet guardrails cannot be averaged away
Next investment and shutdown obligations are explicit

issues.title: Decide the consented repeat-group identity model
issues.outcome: Select an accountless or optional-account model for repeat groups without weakening room isolation.
acceptance: ADR covers consent, recovery, portability, deletion, abuse, and provider lock-in
Anonymous one-off rooms remain available
Provisioning requires owner approval

issues.title: Implement saved group membership and recovery
issues.outcome: Let consenting groups return across devices with explicit membership controls.
acceptance: Membership changes are authorized and auditable
Loss and recovery do not expose old rooms
Leaving a group revokes future access

issues.title: Implement consented saved preferences and constraints
issues.outcome: Save reusable defaults without silently converting safety needs into profiling.
acceptance: Each saved field has purpose, consent, edit, expiry, export, and delete behavior
Hard constraints require confirmation per decision where needed
Analytics never receives raw values

issues.title: Build reusable decision templates
issues.outcome: Let groups save room setup patterns without copying sensitive historical ballots.
acceptance: Templates contain only approved reusable fields
Version changes migrate or fail safely
One-off users can still create rooms directly

issues.title: Implement scheduled decision rituals
issues.outcome: Support recurring prompts such as weekly lunch with explicit opt-in.
acceptance: Schedules are timezone aware and editable
No notification is sent without consent
Missed rituals expire without creating phantom rooms

issues.title: Add privacy-bounded result history
issues.outcome: Show consenting groups useful past decisions without exposing ballots or precise location.
acceptance: History retention is configurable
Venue identity handling matches provider terms
Export and deletion include history

issues.title: Implement transparent repeat-group recommendations
issues.outcome: Use consented history to diversify or recall options with understandable reasons.
acceptance: Recommendation inputs are inspectable and editable
Constraints remain pre-score gates
No hidden sensitive inference is introduced

issues.title: Add preference export, expiry, and deletion controls
issues.outcome: Give people direct control over retained group data.
acceptance: Export is machine-readable and understandable
Deletion revokes access and removes derived data
Expiry jobs and failures are observable

issues.title: Select and approve the notification provider
issues.outcome: Evaluate web push, email, or other channels for consent, cost, deliverability, privacy, and teardown.
acceptance: ADR chooses the minimum viable channel
Quiet hours, unsubscribe, bounce, and abuse behavior are defined
Provisioning requires owner approval

issues.title: Measure repeat-group retention without identity leakage
issues.outcome: Measure repeat utility using consented identifiers and coarse events.
acceptance: One-off anonymous rooms remain unlinkable
Retention windows and cohort rules are documented
Sensitive preference and room content is excluded

issues.title: Verify repeat-group cross-device recovery
issues.outcome: Test membership, saved defaults, history, recovery, export, and deletion across devices.
acceptance: Multi-browser tests cover loss and rotation
Revoked devices cannot regain access
Recovery never changes an active roster silently

issues.title: Run the repeat-utility experiment gate
issues.outcome: Decide whether recurring utility earns continued retention investment.
acceptance: Gate measures opt-in, repeat completion, notification harm, deletion, and support burden
Results include qualitative evidence
Go, revise, or stop decision is recorded

issues.title: Define the reservation and order handoff boundary
issues.outcome: Specify what Consensus may claim before, during, and after third-party handoff.
acceptance: ADR covers deep links, attribution, availability honesty, privacy, errors, and liability
Consensus never claims completion without evidence
Provider selection remains separate

issues.title: Implement safe reservation deep links
issues.outcome: Open approved reservation destinations with correct venue and time context.
acceptance: Links are allowlisted, encoded, attributed, and device tested
Fallback provides a safe search or copy path
No sensitive room data is transmitted

issues.title: Implement safe ordering handoffs
issues.outcome: Open approved ordering destinations without pretending Consensus owns the transaction.
acceptance: Destination and commercial relationship are disclosed
Unavailable handoffs fail honestly
Return flow preserves the decision result

issues.title: Model handoff status and availability honesty
issues.outcome: Represent unknown, opened, externally confirmed, failed, and expired handoff states.
acceptance: UI never equates a click with a booking
Status provenance and timestamp are visible
Stale external confirmations expire

issues.title: Add affiliate and sponsorship disclosure
issues.outcome: Disclose commercial influence wherever ranking or handoff could be affected.
acceptance: Paid placement cannot bypass constraints or masquerade as fairness
Disclosure is accessible and proximal
Organic alternatives remain available

issues.title: Implement privacy-safe monetization events
issues.outcome: Measure outbound handoff and coarse conversion without room or ballot content.
acceptance: Event schema excludes participant, location, constraint, and vote details
Partner parameters are minimized
Retention and reconciliation are documented

issues.title: Evaluate and approve handoff partners
issues.outcome: Compare reservation and ordering partners on terms, coverage, fees, attribution, privacy, and failure modes.
acceptance: Provider matrix and commercial terms are reviewed
Spend and revenue assumptions are explicit
Integration requires owner approval

issues.title: Add controlled monetization feature flags
issues.outcome: Roll out handoff and monetization experiments by environment and cohort with fast disable.
acceptance: Flags fail closed and are auditable
Kill switch removes commercial UI without breaking decisions
Experiment assignment excludes sensitive traits

issues.title: Implement price, fee, and availability transparency
issues.outcome: Show known external fees and uncertainty before handoff.
acceptance: Provider-supplied and estimated amounts are distinct
Missing fees are disclosed as unknown
Currency and locale behavior are tested

issues.title: Handle handoff failure, return, and retry
issues.outcome: Recover when partner apps, links, or sessions fail.
acceptance: Retry is bounded and does not duplicate transactions
Result remains accessible after return
Support guidance names the responsible provider

issues.title: Reconcile revenue and investigate attribution abuse
issues.outcome: Compare privacy-safe outbound records with partner reports and detect fraud.
acceptance: Reconciliation tolerances and disputes are documented
No raw room data is required
Anomalies can disable a partner safely

issues.title: Run the monetization ethics and viability gate
issues.outcome: Decide whether handoff revenue improves sustainability without corrupting trust.
acceptance: Gate measures revenue, completion, confusion, fairness, support, and opt-out
Sponsored influence cannot change safe ranking
Go, revise, or stop decision is recorded

issues.title: Define the category expansion framework
issues.outcome: Specify how new decision categories plug into constraints, evidence, candidates, and handoffs.
acceptance: Core room and fairness rules remain category neutral
Category modules declare schemas and evidence policy
Unsupported categories fail safely

issues.title: Define activity-specific constraints and evidence
issues.outcome: Model time, age, mobility, weather, equipment, distance, and budget evidence for activities.
acceptance: Hard constraints remain pre-score
Unknown and stale evidence are explicit
Safety-sensitive fields receive review

issues.title: Implement the category provider adapter boundary
issues.outcome: Prevent activity or future provider payloads from entering core domain contracts.
acceptance: Adapters emit versioned normalized candidates
Field provenance and license metadata are mandatory
Provider replacement has contract tests

issues.title: Evaluate and approve the first non-food provider
issues.outcome: Select one expansion category and provider using evidence, cost, terms, and coverage.
acceptance: Category choice cites user demand
Provider ADR covers quotas, caching, attribution, deletion, and handoff
Provisioning requires owner approval

issues.title: Build category-adaptive candidate cards and filters
issues.outcome: Render category-specific evidence without fragmenting the core workflow.
acceptance: Mobile hierarchy remains focused and accessible
Buttons remain complete without gestures
Unknown data is not hidden by category styling

issues.title: Create a consented decision-calibration dataset
issues.outcome: Collect minimized outcome feedback suitable for fairness calibration.
acceptance: Dataset excludes raw identities, precise locations, and unnecessary ballots
Consent and deletion propagate to derived data
Sampling limitations are documented

issues.title: Calibrate decision rules across group shapes
issues.outcome: Evaluate satisfaction, least-satisfied outcomes, ties, and veto-like signals without weakening constraints.
acceptance: Ruleset changes are versioned and replayable
Calibration includes adverse subgroup analysis where ethical and feasible
No rule ships solely on aggregate popularity

issues.title: Harden abuse defense for public scale
issues.outcome: Address automated room creation, link scanning, provider scraping, harassment, and resource exhaustion.
acceptance: Controls include detection, prevention, recovery, appeal, and kill switches
Private room content is not used unnecessarily
Load tests cover attack-shaped traffic

issues.title: Prove launch-scale capacity and cost ceilings
issues.outcome: Measure database, realtime, provider, cache, and function limits under projected load.
acceptance: Capacity model includes peak rooms and fan-out
Hard budgets and rejection thresholds are configured
Unit costs feed the 1.0 economics gate

issues.title: Design and test regional failure recovery
issues.outcome: Recover safely from regional compute or data unavailability.
acceptance: RPO and RTO are explicit
Failover cannot create split-brain room authority
Exercise records user-visible degraded behavior

issues.title: Implement provider failover and portability drills
issues.outcome: Prove selected providers can be disabled or replaced within documented thresholds.
acceptance: Export/import and adapter cutover are rehearsed
Licensing and deletion obligations survive exit
Fallback remains honest throughout

issues.title: Complete launch-candidate chaos and recovery review
issues.outcome: Exercise compound failures and verify the product remains safe or clearly unavailable.
acceptance: Scenarios combine database, realtime, provider, network, and abuse faults
No scenario fabricates decisions or venue facts
Release-critical gaps block 1.0

issues.title: Define public-launch SLOs and release criteria
issues.outcome: Turn product promises into measurable availability, correctness, recovery, privacy, and support gates.
acceptance: SLOs have indicators, budgets, owners, and escalation
Constraint safety and decision integrity are top-level gates
Criteria distinguish launch blockers from follow-ups

issues.title: Complete independent application security assessment
issues.outcome: Review anonymous capabilities, APIs, dependencies, infrastructure, and abuse controls before launch.
acceptance: Assessment includes penetration testing and threat-model validation
Critical and high findings are resolved or launch-blocking
Retest evidence is recorded privately and summarized safely

issues.title: Complete privacy, terms, and data-practice review
issues.outcome: Ensure public promises match actual collection, retention, providers, deletion, and monetization.
acceptance: Privacy notice and terms are understandable and accurate
Processor/subprocessor records are current
User requests and provider exits are rehearsed

issues.title: Complete launch accessibility conformance review
issues.outcome: Verify all supported journeys and categories meet the documented accessibility target.
acceptance: Independent audit covers supported devices and assistive technology
Known limitations are public and prioritized
Release-critical barriers are fixed

issues.title: Audit export, deletion, and data portability end to end
issues.outcome: Prove users and operators can retrieve or remove all applicable data.
acceptance: Requests cover primary, cache, analytics, backup, partner, and derived data
Completion evidence avoids exposing content
Failures alert and have recovery procedures

issues.title: Validate unit economics and hard spending controls
issues.outcome: Show a sustainable cost envelope without relying on perpetual free tiers.
acceptance: Per-completed-group costs include every provider and support burden
Budgets, alerts, and kill switches are live
Revenue assumptions are separated from measured results

issues.title: Establish production on-call and observability readiness
issues.outcome: Ensure launch operators can detect, diagnose, communicate, and recover.
acceptance: Dashboards, alerts, rotations, status communication, and runbooks are tested
Sensitive data is absent from telemetry
Alert fatigue and ownership gaps are resolved

issues.title: Pass the final disaster recovery rehearsal
issues.outcome: Recover the production system and verify integrity under the launch RPO/RTO.
acceptance: Restore and failover use documented procedures
Room revision and decision integrity are checked
Results and corrective actions are approved

issues.title: Record launch evidence and the go or no-go decision
issues.outcome: Judge product value, safety, retention, operations, and economics together.
acceptance: Decision cites beta, repeat-use, monetization, scale, audit, and recovery evidence
Unmet safety gates cannot be waived by growth
Rollback and shutdown obligations are explicit

issues.title: Create the verified 1.0 release and public launch
issues.outcome: Promote the approved artifact, publish release records, and begin measured public operation.
acceptance: Exact commit and artifact are verified in Preview and Production
Annotated tag and GitHub Release require explicit owner authorization
Post-launch smoke, monitoring, rollback, and communication are complete
